note: Curated KOSPI themes. Each is a deliberate subset with a stated rule, not a sector renamed.

themes.label: SEMICONDUCTORS
themes.note: Memory, foundry and the equipment and materials behind them — the sector that drives the index.

themes.label: BATTERIES & EV
themes.note: Cell makers, cathode and materials producers, and the chemicals behind the Korean battery chain.

themes.label: DEFENCE
themes.note: Aerospace, land systems, missiles and the electronics suppliers behind Korea's export defence push.

themes.label: BANKS
themes.note: The four big financial holding companies plus the regional banks — the Korea discount in one table.

themes.label: AUTOS & PARTS
themes.note: Hyundai, Kia and the parts chain. Cheap on book value, exposed to the US tariff regime and to the won.

themes.label: INTERNET, MEDIA & TELECOM
themes.note: Search, gaming, content and the carriers. The platforms trade on engagement, the carriers on the dividend.

themes.label: CONSUMER & RETAIL
themes.note: Food, cosmetics and the retail chains — the domestic demand proxy, with cosmetics carrying the export angle.

themes.label: STEEL, CHEMICALS & MATERIALS
themes.note: Steel, petrochemicals and battery materials. Chinese overcapacity sets the spread, which is why these trade at a discount to the index.
